description: The sweep reports what it saw: addresses read, the window, and money-shaped mail it could NOT attribute to any tool. THE COUNTING OBLIGATION: every message you read belongs in exactly one bucket — matched, unmatched_transactional, or not_transactional — and `scanned` must be the total you actually looked at, BEFORE any filtering. Mail you dropped as unparseable still counts. A sweep that filters before it counts reports a flattering gap, and the tab publishes the leftover as `unclassified` rather than absorbing it.

attributed_amount.description: money in this window the sweep DID place on a tool, in the same units as the unmatched amounts

not_transactional.description: messages read and classified as carrying no money

scanned.description: every message read in the window, counted BEFORE filtering — the denominator. Omitting it marks the whole report unaudited.

unmatched_transactional.description: money-shaped mail no tool claimed, one row each

currency.description: ISO 4217 code as the letter stated it; recorded as null when absent, never assumed USD

window_from.description: ISO date the sweep started from

window_to.description: ISO date the sweep read through

name: record_coverage
title: Record Sweep Coverage
